query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name,
  pr.token IS NOT NULL as has_reset_token,
  pr.createdAt as reset_requested_at,
  pr.expiresAt as reset_expires_at,
  pr.usedAt as reset_used_at
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN password_resets pr ON pr.appUserId = u.id
WHERE u.email LIKE '%bayazi%' OR u.email LIKE '%walla%'
ORDER BY pr.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
